```yaml
name: Update Lint Config
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 1'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  update-lint-config:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Update lint config
        run: |
          make update-lint-config
          if git diff --quiet; then
            echo "No changes to commit"
            exit 0
          fi
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add .golangci.yml
          git commit -m "chore: update lint config"
          git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/update-lint-config

      - name: Create Pull Request
        if: success()
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v6
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          branch: update-lint-config
          title: "chore: update lint config"
          body: "This PR updates the lint configuration from upstream."
          commit-message: "chore: update lint config"
          delete-branch: true
```
